Attention.name: MHA / GQA
Attention.summary: Dense attention over a per-head KV cache, with query heads sharing KV heads under GQA.

Attention.name: MLA
Attention.summary: Multi-head latent attention: every head reads one compressed KV latent per token.

Attention.name: DSA
Attention.summary: Sparse MLA: an indexer scores the cache and each query attends only to its top-k tokens.

Attention.name: Gated DeltaNet
Attention.summary: Linear attention: a gated delta-rule state stands in for the KV cache.

kernels.title: All-reduce
kernels.summary: Sum one buffer across the GPUs of a tensor-parallel group.

kernels.title: Paged decode attention
kernels.summary: One query token per request attending over its paged KV cache, for a whole decode batch.

kernels.title: Chunked delta rule, one fused launch
Residual add + RMSNorm
kernels.summary: Add the residual stream, then normalize: the fused step between transformer blocks.

kernels.title: Dense GEMM
kernels.summary: One matrix multiply: an activation block of m tokens times a weight matrix.
